verdicts.reason: A moves the Solstice logo to the top right, where it sits on the pink circle. It shares no edge with the left-aligned headline and copy, which breaks the original's brand-then-headline reading order. The product box is also small and floats above a large empty lower third. B keeps the logo top left as in the original, though it is indented about 45px from the headline's left edge so the two don't quite align. It also gives the product more scale and fills the lower half better. Both use generous single-line text and keep the brand intact, but B's dead band between the copy and the product is a fixable spacing flaw rather than a structural one.
